title: Order with OrderLines
prompt: Define a dataclass OrderLine(sku, quantity, unit_price) and a class Order that starts empty. add_line(sku, quantity, unit_price) appends an OrderLine and returns the line count (raise ValueError if quantity <= 0). total() sums quantity * unit_price. repr(Order()) must contain 'Order'.

tests.name: orderline equality and fields
tests.hint: A dataclass gives field equality for free.

tests.name: add returns count; total computes
tests.code:
o = Order()
assert o.add_line('tea', 2, 3) == 1
assert o.add_line('cup', 1, 10) == 2
assert o.total() == 16

tests.name: invalid quantity raises
tests.code:
o = Order()
try:
    o.add_line('x', 0, 5)
    failed = False
except ValueError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Validate quantity at the boundary: raise ValueError when <= 0.

tests.name: repr mentions Order
tests.hint: Define __repr__ or reuse a readable default.
